body:
Refresh all nine suites using their upstream default branches.
The corpus headers, revision lock and competitor inventory record
the exact commit SHA, date, original license and source URLs.

Validation: importer, literal extraction and checkout tests passed.
Review the corpus diff for changed expectations or retired cases.
The coverage baseline is preserved so the normal CI coverage gate
can flag regressions and removals for review.

Reproduce with `make checkout-corpus` followed by `make import-corpus`.
See [the refresh guide](https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator/blob/main/docs/competitor-corpus.md).

commits.messageHeadline: chore: refresh upstream calculator test corpus
